subject.title: Add logging and warnings for cron job execution failures

question: Which public cron health/readiness contract should OpenClaw expose for failed, skipped, or overdue cron jobs?
rationale: The logging and CLI pieces are bounded, but endpoint and 200/503 readiness semantics become operator-facing Gateway API behavior on stable surfaces.

options.title: Fold Cron Into Existing Probes
options.body: Add cron degradation to the existing health/readiness/RPC model first, without creating a new component route unless maintainers later need it.

options.title: Add Dedicated Cron Route
options.body: Implement `/health/cron` with explicit cron-only status semantics and accept the new public operator contract.

options.title: Ship Local Visibility First
options.body: Land all-outcome runtime logging and CLI annotations now, leaving endpoint semantics for a later owner-approved design.

recommendation.title: Fold Cron Into Existing Probes
recommendation.body: Add cron degradation to the existing health/readiness/RPC model first, without creating a new component route unless maintainers later need it.

likelyOwner.reason: He supplied the latest detailed issue context and has recent cross-cutting cron scheduling/status history.
